candidates.scope: Field limit only; zero boundary; square lattice; no SLE claim.

theorem.quantifiers: For every bounded C2 Jordan domain D and every sequence of simply connected inside approximations D_delta by delta Z^2 with uniformly convergent boundary parametrizations, sample h_delta from normalized Lebesgue measure on P_delta.
theorem.model: P_delta={h:V(D_delta)->R : h=0 on boundary; |h(u)-h(v)|<=1 for every nearest-neighbor square-lattice edge uv}.
theorem.claim: There exists sigma_sq>0 independent of D and the approximation sequence such that h_delta/sigma_sq converges as a random distribution to the Dirichlet GFF on D with covariance (-Delta_D)^(-1).

proof_spans: PDF pp. 6-8: local triangular block deficit and sparse defects
PDF §§4-5: reflected coupling and stationary tangent response
source_mechanism.transfer_idea: Preserve convex filling-volume log-concavity, exposed-facet curvature, sparse defects, and stationary reflected tangent response while changing the local graph from triangular to square. The general finite-dimensional slice-log-concavity step is graph independent.

decisive_missing_lemma.statement: For Q_L={0,...,L}^2 with graph distance d1, fix delta,delta0>0,k0 and L sufficiently large relative to (k0+2)/delta0. For every shell s extending to h with |Delta h|<=1-delta on all edges and |h(x)-h(y)|<=(1-delta0)d1(x,y) whenever d1(x,y)>=k0, and every chi with vol K(s+chi),vol K(s-chi)>0, prove F(s)-0.5(F(s+chi)+F(s-chi)) >= c max_{v,w in C}|chi(v)-chi(w)|^2, where F=log vol K and C is the four side-midpoints; c is independent of s,chi.
decisive_missing_lemma.status: unproved; a weighted Manhattan edge-length exposure is a proof sketch only
decisive_missing_lemma.why_load_bearing: This is the local curvature input that feeds sparse-block coercivity and the reflected-diffusion/GFF identification.

compatibility_obligations: Re-establish sparse-block estimates and their extension from zero pins to square-grid conditional kernels.
Show the stationary reflected square-grid tangent limit has finite positive effective stiffness.
Carry conditional Dirichlet covariance identification through square-grid kernels.
candidates.early_falsifier: For rational good shell data on small square boxes, find exact or certified filling-volume ratios for opposite-side perturbations. A sequence with midpoint-deficit / max-face-difference-squared tending to zero falsifies the proposed uniform block lemma and this transfer route. A bounded-size pass is not proof.
